verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a catalog of 600+/700+ connectors spanning APIs, databases, warehouses, and files, plus a no-code Connector Builder and AI Assistant for building custom connectors when the catalog lacks one. However, community feedback notes there is no clear way to check a connector's maintenance/support status, and no independent audit of connector quality/freshness is present. missing for 10: independent verification of connector maintenance quality, clear connector support-tier visibility, and broader hands-on corroboration beyond one HN complaint.
